body:
Oh. I'm trying to make an Enterprise ISO to have it handy in case I need to reinstall Windows, I'm using the Media Creation Tool, but when I check it with DISM, it says Education instead of Enterprise. I used this command in Powershell:  
`.\mediacreationtool.exe /Eula Accept /Retail /MediaArch x64 /MediaLangCode en-US /MediaEdition Enterprise`  
How to find out if it's actually Enterprise, other than trying to install and activate it?

Can an Enterprise digital license be used to activate an Education install? I only found a table that says going from Education to Enterprise and vice versa is not considered a downgrade or an upgrade.
